about: Sense MIN_MAX and Offset (types/0x0030-sense.md; zadania/zrobione/DEVICE-01.md N10, N11): profile env, ep4 TEMPERATURE. MinMeasured/MaxMeasured are absent until the first good reading, follow the extremes of Value and skip failed readings (§5.2). They are stored at most once every 10 minutes, and only when they changed — counted from the start — and at once after ResetMinMax (§5.7), which sets both to the current Value (§3). Value is the reading plus Offset; a new Offset applies from the next measurement and does not recompute the extremes (§5.1). The cycle is switched off so that only measurements report.

steps.note: no cycle on ep4: only what the scenario is about goes out
before any measurement MinMeasured is absent
a failed reading is no minimum
nothing stored yet: under 10 minutes since the start
20.10 °C, 9 min 59 s after the start: still not stored
10 minutes: the next measurement stores both
a new maximum 100 s after the store is kept back
10 minutes after the last store: stored
sets MinMeasured to the current Value
Value does not move until the next measurement
the extremes follow Value, the one after calibration
